content: Khazing le Abuipaw Zisu Khri aa sae a cangpaw kama Jeims tah raang hlupui letah a paipatlawpaw mingphing phing hrawhluihningpaw khah kihtlenah ca ka ca kua he.
Hnehsahnah le tuhsonah
Ka uny sahlo, hnehsahnah a phingphing na tong ning maikaw he ceh tah lunglawngnah a cang tah my lo,
zecawtamaw tatah naa zingnah hnehsahnah takhei terianah a chuakhui tah cawh naa hni thlang kho.
Terianah khah naaning letah ung paria thlang my seh lo. Ma pawsui co zehmai a hia khawh lypaw apuitling paw le a tlangtling pawtah naa cang khy a.
Singnah a phahlahpaw naa ung caco, pánah ming ly tei zezongpui khah sai ngetei tah a peipaw Khazing khaco hae seh la, peh a cang thlang a.
Canghrasala a hae tihtah lung pachipabah lytah zing hrahring seh, zecawtamaw tatah a lung a pachih a pah bahpaw cawngsaw cawh rili tuileh thli tei a phopahai laipaw hapaw lungreh a hnui lypaw a cang.
Ma cawngsaw taco Abuipaw taitah zetei ze ly ka hmuh a tahpaw a rawh kheh seh;
ama cawh lung kangrahning a hnuipaw, a tuapaw hming vytei letah lungreh a hnui lypaw cawngsaw a cang.
A sisahpaw uny cawh Khazing tah a cuicaling tihtah a palaikhui seh.
Canghrasala mehrung a cangpaw cawh Khazing tah a zochuhsah tihtah a palaikhui seh, zecawtamaw tatah ama cawh araang pa hratah a zung a.
Ning cawh ka chuh ka, a paling tihtah pangpa kung cawh a ui. A pa cawh zung ka, a ngenah cawh a ly. Ma tei hraco mehrungpaw zong a rai a hre leimei ning takhei hmai a ly thlang a.

Hnehsahnah rai letei te a ria thlangpaw cawngsaw cawh bonghnang a ting, zecawtamaw tatah hnehsahnah khah a ing khy tihtah Khazing tah Ama a dopaw sahlo bia a kangpaw he hringnah builukhu khah a hmuh a.
Tuhsonah naa ing tihtah ahotahmai tah, “Khazing tah a pa tuhso,” tah kheh he seh. Zecawtamaw tatah Khazing cawh chahlynah tah a tuhso khypaw cang be, Ama zong tah ahohmai tuhso bang hrah bei he;
canghrasala cawngsaw pakheh cawh achaw lypaw a dunahpaw takhei laipasong ka, a hruihly tihtah tuhso a cangpaw a cang.
Mataico dunah taco sawtei pho ka, suanah khah sah ka, suanah taco a pui a ka tling tihtah thihnah khah a sah.
Ka dopaw uny sahlo, dungkhei chuhchypaw cang khe lo.
Chahnah maikaw le a tlingpaw lahsong cawh cung lang taiteipaw cang ka, vaicung khainah sahlo Paw a cangpaw, a thlai laipaw ningpahlipaw hratei a thlailai lypaw taitah a vongpaw a cang.
Ama a tuapaw vytei letah sa-uthui kaa cang nápaw cawtah biahmuisui thongtah hringnah peh a pawtah a ma thing.
Thuinah le tuanah
Ka dopaw uny sahlo, ma heh a ngia thlang my lo: Ahohmai thuinah lang leco a catleipaw cang la, biarei le thingae leco a hawngsang my lo,
zecawtamaw tatah mehnung thingaenah tahei Khazing a dupaw, a dingpaw hringnah a chuakhui ly cawtah a cang.
Macawtaco thinglung lang tei a pialuipaw le hmingting letei a ungpaw chahlynah khah pathaisah hly thlu la, naaning a ca pachah khypaw he, naaning letei tupaw bia khah apanynah cung tah a lah my lo.
Bia heh a thui longtei thuinahpaw khei naaning le naaning a dungkhei khe lo. A reipaw khah tua hri my lo.
Bia cawh thui thlang tlung katei, a reipaw hratah a tua lypaw cawngsaw cawh thlalang letei a hme a mingpaw cawngsaw khatah a lo ka,
a ming khy taitah seihly ka, zemaw ka lo takhah sungkheh teitah a monghly thah.

Canghrasala zalongnah a peipaw phungbia letah a mingchai thlang katei, a ming paria thlangpaw cawngsaw cawh a thuipaw khah monghly be ca ka, rai tukhah hre hri ka, ama cawh a tuapaw letah bonghnang song a cang a.
Pakheh kheh tah kama cawh behnah thisaw a hnuipaw ka cang tah seh la, a lui khah cyky tah a tlepakhih ly caco, ama le ama a dungkhei ka, a behnah cawh sang a tle lypaw a cang.

A pathaipaw le pánah a hnui lypaw tei kaa Paw Khazing tah a cyhlangpaw behnah cawh ma heh a cang. Haraw sahlo le lahme sahlo khah aa ruhanah letah mingkai le khazaw pialuinah taitah a vai khah a cang.
